name: processtask_collection_phase_task

description: The process task_collection_phase_task table, which belongs to the process module, is used for related queries and report queries related to the process.

fields.name: phase_id
fields.description: Stage_id, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.description: Work order ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.
